answer.reason: The verses tell of Jehoram's killing of his brothers, the Philistine and Arabian invasion, and his incurable disease, which the summary does not state as events.

clauses.english: slew all his brothers with the sword when he became king
clauses.quote: slew all his brethren with the sword

clauses.english: was invaded by Philistines and Arabians, who carried off his house's wealth and his sons
clauses.quote: carried away all the substance that was found in the king's house

clauses.english: was struck by the LORD with an incurable disease of the bowels
clauses.quote: the LORD smote him in his bowels with an incurable disease

doubts: 1KI 16:28 (Omri) and 2KI 1:17 (Jehoram son of Ahab, king of Israel, takes the throne) are marked but concern others or only mention the Judah king for dating; left out.
2KI 8:29 and 2KI 9:24 mention Joram/Jehoram son of Ahab of Israel, not this record; left out.
2KI 8:21 and 2CH 21:9 tell of a night battle against the Edomites; left out in favour of the three chief events.
2KI 11:2, 2KI 12:18, 1CH 3:11, 2CH 22:6, 2CH 22:11 and MAT 1:8 only mention him as a father or ancestor or concern others, so they were not used.
